title: Fix mobile chat overflow with scrollable message list and wrapped content

requirements.text: Prevent chat messages from overflowing outside the chat panel on mobile by ensuring the message list area scrolls vertically while keeping the composer (message input + buttons) visible within the chat card.

quotes: when the messages and reply start to accumulate in chat the messages go outside the chat box

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile-sized viewports, adding enough messages causes the chat message area to scroll vertically instead of growing beyond the chat panel bounds.
The message composer area (input, send button, attachment UI) remains accessible and does not get pushed off-screen as messages accumulate.
No horizontal scrolling is introduced in the chat panel during normal use.

requirements.text: Ensure long chat message text wraps onto the next line within the available chat width (including deeply nested replies) without causing horizontal overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Long message content wraps naturally within the chat panel width on mobile (no text rendering outside the card).
Very long unbroken strings (e.g., long URLs) do not force horizontal overflow; they break/wrap within the message container.
Reply content exhibits the same wrapping behavior as top-level messages.

requirements.text: Make attached chat images responsive on mobile so that image previews and posted images never exceed the chat panel width and do not contribute to overflow.

quotes: when the messages and reply start to accumulate in chat the messages go outside the chat box

acceptanceCriteria: Posted images scale down to fit within the chat panel on mobile (no overflow beyond the card).
Image attachment previews in the composer also scale appropriately on mobile.
Image aspect ratio is preserved and images remain viewable (no unintended cropping that hides most of the image).

requirements.text: Update the chat panel containers where they are embedded (e.g., standalone Chat page and Calendar month page) so the chat region uses a stable, mobile-safe height calculation and does not cause nested overflow issues when the message list scrolls.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the chat panel fits within its parent container on the Chat page and Calendar month page without content spilling outside the intended chat box.
The chat message list scroll works correctly in both embeddings (standalone chat page and calendar page).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only components must be composed, not modified).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add new chat features (e.g., typing indicators, real-time updates, new reaction types).
Do not change backend data models or Motoko canister logic for this fix.
